assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md lines 25-26 mark the affected version range as 'Imprecise -- versions prior to the fix (no specific version threshold provided in Jira description)' and fixed version as 'Imprecise -- see advisory (no specific version provided in Jira description)'. Lines 43-44 state 'The Jira description lacks a specific version threshold for the affected range.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 7-17 show query to https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901 and extraction from the versions array: 'status: affected, lessThan: 0.4.8, versionType: semver'. Extracted fix threshold stated as '< 0.4.8'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 19-29 show query to https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901 and extraction from 'The ranges array contains a SEMVER range with events: introduced: 0, fixed: 0.4.8'. Extracted fix threshold stated as 'fixed at 0.4.8'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 31-44 show cross-validation table comparing Jira, MITRE, and OSV.dev sources. States 'Result: Agreement. Both MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev agree on the fix threshold: 0.4.8' and 'Enriched fix threshold: 0.4.8 (authoritative, from cross-validated external sources)'. Explicitly states 'This enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) will be used as the authoritative value for version impact comparisons in Step 2.3'.

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 4-5 state 'Using the enriched fix threshold from Step 1.5: h2 < 0.4.8 is affected. This threshold was cross-validated by both MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev (agreement). The imprecise Jira description data (versions prior to the fix) was not used for version impact comparison.' The version impact table uses 0.4.8 as the comparison threshold throughout (e.g., '0.4.5 < 0.4.8', '0.4.8 >= 0.4.8').
